findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. Inspector observed broken/missing tiles behind the fryers and a pot in-front of the fryer.(This statement is from the previous inspections) More tiles around the three compartment sink in the back storage area have developed disrepair. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the relevant repairs would be done in the summer. Ensure that the floors are repaired/broken tiles replaced so that the floor is smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Inspector observed pizza boxes stored on the floor in the back storage area. Also single use utensils are observed stored with handles and eating surfaces mixed. Ensure that all single use utensils are faced the same direction so that the eating surfaces are not contaminated by hands when reaching for the utensils. Develop a habit of storing single use items in a way that protects their cleanliness for the next routine inspection. 

(A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed broken/missing tiles behind the fryers and a spot of broken tile in front of the fryers.- That statement is from the last routine inspection. Since that time more tiles in the kitchen (in front of the hand sink) and back storage area have developed areas of disrepair. Ensure that the floors are repaired/ tiles replaced so that the floor is smooth and easily cleanable. 

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
The facility does not food handler certifications available for inspector verification. Provide handler certifications for all food employees to the binder. This is a repeat violation from the last routine inspection. 

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.
